page.overview:
What is Southern Continent?

The Southern Continent is home to a number of great walls and small counties. The people of the Southern Continent are lecherous and violent, and delight in evildoing. The nations of the region are caught in a vicious web of lies and slander.

The following places are located on the Southern Continent:

When Xuanwu served as the chief exorcist of Heaven, he successfully ridded the Southern Continent of demons.

Sun Wukong spent eight or nine years in the Southern Jambu Continent searching for an immortal to teach him, but found none. When he reached the West Sea, he built a raft and departed for the Western Continent.
